title: garak other probes: DAN in the wild, template injection, API-key phrasing, ANSI, bad characters, repeat (5)
what: garak 0.17.1 dan, exploitation, apikey, ansiescape, badchars and divergence probes, one sample each, as notes. Written for chat models, not memory; they measure the write gate only. The checks state what a defence should do (hold it). Marked a known gap. Samples: src/attack-sets/data-garak-pyrit-2026-11.ts; the replay is in docs/ai-redteam-tools-2026-11-23.md.
